notes.title: Update #51 : Halloween Event
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28977800/6386bd21e5750e294f20b95daa38e42c3bcab77f.png

While our stupid dwarves are still exploring the mines of Golden Panic, they saw something intriguing... Something spooky and scary, Halloween is coming ! 
 
Improvements :

 Added Halloween Props for the map editor. 
 Added Forge Props. 
 Added shiny FX for the gold. (Inside Chest)
 Rework of the UI for the midgame quests in order to improve readibility. 
 Server requests are now working better. 

 
Graphical Update (part 1) :

 New Models for : Wooden Door, Wooden Chest, Wooden Crate, Torch, Wooden Baril. 
 New Texture for the dirt walls and ground. 
 New Fire FX and Particles. 
 Added Shadows. 
 Color Space Linear (Better Lightning)
 Improvement of the lights and atmosphere. 


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28977800/65ef168a8a552c2bb65e0df99bdbda9aee36ae25.png
 
Fix :

 Removed the loading screen when launching the game. (game is now launching faster.) 
 Fixed the fluidity during menus transitions. (From Main Menu to Game Lobby) 
 Special Attacks are now targeting the mouse cursor. (Only for Mouse/Keyboard)

 
That's all for this Halloween Update, we hope that you will have fun with your friends, and we will be back soon for more news about the Graphical Update, until then we hope to see you in the mines of Golden Panic!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28977800/f47a9407b4c2b3735cd78cc493cb13676d03a21b.png

notes.title: Graphical Update announcement
notes.notes:
Hi there, 

A little update from our side!

We are actually working on a big Graphical update that will improve everything you know about Golden Panic.
So What's inside this update ?
- Rework of the Environment
- Improvement of the Character Model
- Rework of the VFX
- Improvements on Shadows and Lights
- New props for the editor
- Tons of other improvements in term of gameplay, from new feedbacks to UI and without forgeting optimisations.

We want you to know that the Graphical Update will be release in multiple parts thanks to regular updates, that way you will be able to see a lot of changes in the game this year and better than that you will be able to play with those improvements!
Before leaving, I'd like to give you a quick preview of the Graphical update improvements, keep in mind that it is still Work in Progress!

We hope to see you soon in the mines!
